title: Data Scientist
text: Data Scientist at Sterning Group (Sydney, ; Full Time; salary: not stated). This is an amazing opportunity to step out from the shadows into this autonomous Data Science role within a savvy, fast-growing Digital Data Science team. The team has grown rapidly in the last two years from a handful to twenty people across Data Science, Actuarial, Digital & BI. This role sits within the Digital space, where you’ll be regularly using tech such as Python & R work on statistical models and a major Digital Analytics project which is closely linked to their core strategy. Key requirements & responsibilities: Be able to liaise with stakeholders and interpret business problems to collaborate on how to best approach business problems Confidently utilize tech such as Python and R to work on statistical models targeted towards Digital Analytics Proactive approach to problem solving. This is a commercially-savvy business. They need someone that has the technical capability but also is able to prioritise their tasks to keep their stakeholders happy. Exposure to a strategic project in the Digital Analytics space that your Manager will be working on as well as opportunities within the extended team to expand on your growth as a developing Data Scientist. Contact me on 0430 327 094 or Nakul@Sterning.com if you have further questions. A $500 Referral voucher is available for this role!
